P1: 15号道路 is a hilly path that leads east from 浅红市 to 14号道路.
D1: West side of the hill (requires 居合斩)
D2: On the southern, eastbound path, between the second and third ledges
D3: Sometimes given out by Twins Kay & Tia, after registering their phone number
P2: 14号道路 is a pleasant coastal road where the salty breeze blows in from the sea. The path runs north to 13号道路.
D4: From the woman in the tall grass patch, if the player's lead Pokémon is 吉利蛋 (requires 居合斩)
D5: Sometimes given out by Bird Keeper Josh, after registering his phone number
P3: Use 居合斩 to reach the tall grass patch. Speak to the woman here, and she asks if you know which Pokémon is the cutest in the world. According to her, that title belongs to 吉利蛋, and nothing can be done to change her mind. If you speak to her again with a Chansey in the party, she gives out a 吉利拳.
P4: As you move northward along the road, you run across 水君 yet again, standing out among the waves. It flees like usual, racing northward over the water's surface. Eusine arrives a moment later, and states that he is beginning to understand what the legendary beast may be hoping to find. He would rather keep the info to himself, but wants to prove himself an honest Trainer to Suicune, and so shares the clue with you. According to him, Suicune prefers a hilly place near water, somewhere north. He is not sure exactly where just yet, and challenges you to see who can find the place first.
P5: 13号道路 is a difficult, narrow path that leads eastward toward 12号道路. Many Trainers can be found among the maze of fences.
D6: One step east of the Trainer Tips sign (hidden)
D7: Sometimes given out by Camper Tanner, after registering his phone number
P6: 12号道路 connects 13号道路, 11号道路, and 紫苑镇. Also known as Silence Bridge, it is a favorite spot for Fishermen.
D8: In the southernmost clearing (requires 冲浪, 居合斩)
D9: In the northern of the two clearings (requires 居合斩)
D10: Fishing Guru's house; from his younger brother
D11: North of the fence on the path to Route 11 (hidden; requires 冲浪)
P7: The house to the south of the intersection with 11号道路 is home to the Fishing Guru's younger brother. Speak to him to receive the 厉害钓竿. This high-end fishing rod is the best model available and can reel in some of the strongest sea creatures.
